channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday contests 2026 (Canada)
channel.description: 4 Canadian Black Friday contests and prize draws are open for 2026; this page lists contests and prize draws, not retail sale deals; the next deadline is November 30, 2026 (ACON, Apollo Imports Inc) and the last is December 3, 2026 (Floral Acres Greenhouse & Garden Centre).

item.title: ACON Black Friday 2026 "Ultimate Backyard Setup" Giveaway (Canada) – ACON
item.description: Prize: ACON X 17ft trampoline + Soccer Goal Panel + Basketball Hoop with Back Net (worth CA$6,477). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Sign up with your email on ACON's Canadian Black Friday page (joins the ACON VIP newsletter). Free. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 1:00 AM EST

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (CA) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV CA$999) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. Canadian residents of the age of majority. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: Canada Pooch Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway: win a $150 gift card – Canada Pooch Ltd
item.description: Prize: One $150 CAD Canada Pooch gift card (to use on the Canada Pooch website). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Enter a valid email address in the sweepstakes entry form on canadapooch.com and click "Enter to Win". One entry per person and email. Marketing opt-in is optional. Legal residents of Canada 18+ (or age of majority), void in Quebec. Nov 5 – Dec 1, 2026, 11:59:59 pm EST. No purchase necessary

item.title: Floral Acres Long Black Friday Giveaway 2026: plants and prize packs – Floral Acres Greenhouse & Garden Centre (Central Botanical Growers Ltd., Saskatoon)
item.description: Prize: Five selectable main prizes (14" Monstera Deliciosa CA$139.98, Kikkerland footed flip clock CA$169.98, 6" variegated Dragon's Tail CA$119.98, Gentlemen's and Ladies' prize packs ~CA$100 each) plus a Black Friday door crasher (Agave 'Blue Glow', in-store only, Nov 27) and a Cyber Monday door crasher (10" Cereus Monstrosus CA$259.98, online orders Nov 30). Prizes are picked up in Saskatoon. Deadline: December 3, 2026. Free entry: email orderdesk@floralacres.ca with the subject «Black Friday Giveaway Entry», your full name, email and the prize you want, or request a free ballot in store; purchases also give entries. Max 5 entries per person per day. Legal residents of Canada, 18+. Nov 20 – Dec 3, 2026 11:59 p.m. CST
